articles.title: Ontology Graph Springs to Life After Critical Edge Parser Fix

content.exec: A silent data loss bug in the ontology pipeline, which dropped all relationship edges since inception, was corrected in dictionary_extractor.py. This fix materialized the full 116-edge knowledge graph for the first time, enabling structural analysis.
content.tech:
Root Cause: The EDGE_PATTERN regex in dictionary_extractor.py exclusively matched forward arrows (→/->), silently ignoring the widespread use of reverse arrows (←) in dictionary files for relationships like 'contained-by'.
Fix: The regex was updated to capture both arrow directions and handle parenthetical descriptions following edge targets.
Result: The ontology registry immediately populated with 116 edges across 48 terms, with 114 resolving to known nodes. Two new test cases covering reverse and mixed-direction edges were added to prevent regression.
content.graph:
// KNOWLEDGE GRAPH DELTA
NODE(OntologyGraph) | status: UNREACHABLE → MATERIALIZED
NODE(Term) | connectivity: 0 → N
EDGE(Term)-[RELATIONSHIP]->(Term) | count: 0 → 116
NEW_CAPABILITY(GraphPathfinding)
NEW_CAPABILITY(CentralityAnalysis)

articles.title: Major Frontend Refactor Deployed, Unifying UI Patterns and Exposing Infrastructure Gaps

content.exec: The minor-fixes-fe branch, containing a complete UI navigation rewrite, was successfully merged and deployed. This introduced new sidebar and tabbed page patterns while exposing critical infrastructure weaknesses in worker disk management and CI webhook visibility.
content.tech:
Scope: The merge consolidated ~85 file changes from 36 commits, resolving 9 git conflicts. Key changes include a double-sidebar navigation, tabbed page decomposition, and a new PendingDocuments module.
Conflict Resolution: The obsolete current_phase feature, spanning 11 files, was removed to prevent migration conflicts.
Verification: 23 new tests were added to cover new backend features like the pending-overview endpoint and schema manifest builder API.
Exposed Risks: The deployment revealed two systemic infrastructure flaws: worker disk space accumulation from build artifacts and opaque Vercel webhook failures, both requiring remediation.

articles.title: Domain-Tagging Constitution Ratified, Embedding Business Vocabulary into Code and Agent Workflows

content.exec: A new domain-tagging system using @biz/@sys docstring tags was designed and ratified, creating a machine-readable bridge between business concepts in the ontology and their implementation in the codebase. This governance was then embedded into core agent workflows, making domain-awareness an enforceable, automated behavior.
content.tech:
Mechanism: The system relies on Python docstring tags (e.g., @biz(term="Remessa", type="Event")) coupled directly to code symbols.
Foundation: This is supported by a restructured business dictionary (dictionary-business.md) organized by domain (Core, Aquisição, Documents) with explicit taxonomy_type and edge definitions.
Enforcement: Agent behavior is governed by updates to CLAUDE.md, which now routes tasks to specific skills for dictionary maintenance (Route 3) and code tagging (Route 4), ensuring compliance.
content.graph:
// KNOWLEDGE GRAPH DELTA
NEW_EDGE(CodeSymbol)-[ANNOTATED_BY]->(OntologyTerm)
NEW_NODE(AgentWorkflow::{concern: 'DictionaryMaintenance'})
NEW_NODE(AgentWorkflow::{concern: 'CodeTagging'})
NODE(Codebase) | state: Opaque → Queryable
AXIOM_ESTABLISHED('Code is an extension of the knowledge graph')

articles.title: Critical Frontend Performance Bottleneck Eliminated by Stripping Bloated API Payloads

content.exec: A severe frontend performance issue causing browser freezes on bulk import pages was traced to oversized API responses. The issue was resolved by removing extracted_data and ocr_text fields from the list view endpoint, reducing payload size by over 80%.
content.tech:
Problem: The BulkImportDetailView.get() endpoint was serializing full OCR text for every document in its list response, creating multi-megabyte JSON payloads that froze the browser.
Backend Fix: The serializer in views.py:1035-1045 was modified to exclude the extracted_data and ocr_text fields from the document dictionary for the list view.
Frontend Fix: The openPreview function in BulkImportTable.tsx was rewritten to fetch full document data on-demand when a user clicks to view a preview, aligning with established lazy-loading patterns.
content.graph:
// KNOWLEDGE GRAPH DELTA
NEW_AXIOM('List endpoints must not serialize large text or binary fields')
REFINES_NODE(APIDesignConstitution)
DIFFERENTIATES_NODE(Entity::SummaryView) from NODE(Entity::DetailView)
NEW_EDGE(PerformanceRequirement)-[DRIVES]->(APISchemaRefinement)

articles.title: Commit Message Constitution Ratified, Revealing 'Constitution-to-Skill' Architectural Pattern

content.exec: A new constitution was established to enforce a strict, structured format for all git commit messages. This process revealed a key architectural pattern: every high-level Constitution document should be paired with a compact, executable Skill file for direct use by AI agents.
content.tech:
Standard: The new commit standard mandates conventional prefixes (fix, feat, refactor), an imperative subject line, and a structured body detailing what, why, impact, test summary, and spec references.
Pattern Discovery: The key insight was the need to separate the lengthy, human-readable constitution from a concise, context-window-friendly skill file (e.g., commit-message.md) that agents can load at execution time for direct instruction.
content.graph:
// KNOWLEDGE GRAPH DELTA
NEW_META_EDGE(Constitution)-[PRODUCES]->(Skill)
This formalizes the link between declarative system rules (NODE(Constitution)) and procedural agent knowledge (NODE(Skill)).
It establishes a clear pathway from high-level governance to low-level, automated enforcement.
REFINES_NODE(AgentWorkflow) | attribute: constitutionally_driven

articles.title: Systematic Contract Matching Failure Resolved via Check-Digit Normalization

content.exec: A persistent failure in matching CCB contracts during bulk import was traced to a mismatch in number formatting. The issue was resolved by implementing a normalization step that strips the trailing check-digit from extracted numbers before database lookup.
content.tech:
Root Cause: Extracted CCB numbers from PDFs contained a check digit (e.g., 600913767-7), while the canonical numbers in the upstream database were purely numeric (600913767), causing exact-match lookups to fail silently.
Solution: A normalization function is now applied to the extracted value upon ingestion, ensuring data format consistency across the pipeline before any database comparison occurs.
content.graph:
// KNOWLEDGE GRAPH DELTA
NEW_RULE('All external identifiers must be normalized to a canonical form upon ingestion')
REFINES_NODE(Identifier::CCB) | adds attribute: canonical_format
NEW_EDGE(DataIngestionPipeline)-[ENFORCES]->(NormalizationRule)
FALSIFIED_ASSUMPTION('External data formats are consistent with internal representations')

articles.title: Core Dictionaries Overhauled, Establishing Domain-Alignment and Machine-Readable Taxonomies

content.exec: The business and system dictionaries underwent a significant restructuring and cleanup, organizing terms by business domain, establishing formal taxonomy types and relationship edges, and resolving critical ambiguities. This makes the entire domain vocabulary machine-queryable and aligned with the codebase.
content.tech:
Restructuring: The dictionary-business.md was reorganized from a flat list into domain-aligned sections: Core/Shared, Aquisição, and Documents & OCR.
Enrichment: All 24 core terms were updated with explicit taxonomy_type and edge definitions, providing structured data for the ontology pipeline.
Cleanup: Contradictions in the system dictionary, such as the log_event vs. log_event_safe ambiguity, were resolved, and missing system concepts like parent_event and filter_key were added.
Validation: The changes were validated via an end-to-end audit using the extraction pipeline itself.
content.graph:
// KNOWLEDGE GRAPH DELTA
UPGRADES_SCHEMA(KnowledgeGraph)
NODE(Term) → NODE(Domain) contains NODE(Term)
ENRICHES_NODE(Term) | adds attribute: taxonomy_type
ENRICHES_NODE(Term) | adds attribute: edges
This work provides the structured raw material for the now-functional edge parser, upgrading the graph's foundational schema.

articles.title: L7 Reframed as Emergent Property, Unifying Meta-Representation Framework

content.exec: A deep assessment of the meta-representations framework resulted in a significant conceptual shift, reframing the L7 architecture not as a designed construct but as an emergent property of the system's adaptive formalization processes. This insight identified the uncertainty-investment curve as the framework's core unifying principle.
content.tech:
Change Type: This was a non-code, conceptual change focused on updating core documentation in docs/business-philosopher/assuntos/meta-representations/.
Artifacts Produced: The sessions generated new conceptual models, including an abstract-concrete evidence map and a documented intellectual lineage for the DomainSpec concept.
Impact: The work structurally reshaped the project's guiding thesis, providing a new lens through which to evaluate architectural decisions and system evolution.
content.graph:
// KNOWLEDGE GRAPH DELTA
RECLASSIFIES_NODE(L7_Architecture) | type: Designed → Emergent
NEW_NODE(UncertaintyInvestmentCurve)
NEW_EDGE(UncertaintyInvestmentCurve)-[GOVERNS]->(AdaptiveFormalization)
NEW_EDGE(UncertaintyInvestmentCurve)-[EXPLAINS]->(L7_Architecture)
This change operates at the meta-level of the ontology, altering the system's self-conception.
